pairs.why: The two hats are nearly identical; A's soft satin sheen on the crown and its fuller, chunkier brim sit slightly closer to the matte-plastic finish of the graduation cap, while B has a sharper specular rim.
A's slightly softer, less specular black and more saturated, cleaner red band read a little closer to the soft toy-like finish of the real cards, while B's crown has a brighter glossy edge highlight.
The hats are almost the same, but A's gentler highlight and rounder, chunkier brim match the soft matte rendering of the real cards a bit better than B's crisper sheen.
There's very little difference, but A keeps a soft satin finish like the real cap and pillow, while B leans a touch glossier at the crown rim.
A's canopy shows a visible fabric-weave mottle, which is the 'too texture-y' failure, while B's smoother purple gradient matches the clean, softly shaded fan and beach umbrella.
A's canopy and lace carry more grainy cloth texture, while B's smoother shading is closer to the clean, slightly soft finish of the real cards without going ultra-smooth.
B's canopy is smoother with gentle gradients like the real fan, while A shows noticeable surface grain on the purple fabric.
A has the most visible fabric texture and harsher lace detail, while B's smoother, softly lit canopy reads closer to the real cards' clean toy-like finish.
